name: Xinxing Lüeying
source:
In the distant future—humanity has long since crossed the stars, with civilizations spread across countless worlds.

Yet beneath this age of freedom and prosperity, crime thrives just as boundlessly.

To maintain order, the Interstellar Government established a Bounty System, sending hunters across the cosmos to capture criminals for reward.—But Fellan is no hunter.

He’s just an unlucky ship captain, running on empty fuel and drifting on the brink of space.

His daily routine? Daydreaming about high-value bounties on the news.

Until one day—A mysterious man known only as “7” emerges from the shadows, and with a gun, forces a new course upon his life.

Bound together against their will, the two embark on a perilous journey across the solar system—From eerie space stations and chaotic Titan, to trade-dominated Mars and the desolate silence of Earth…

Through missions and narrow escapes, Fellan begins to realize: “7” is no ordinary human.

His overwhelming strength stems from a forbidden substance—the Nova Serum.

Powerful. Dangerous. And not without its cost.

So what is this journey, really? A bond slowly forming… or a descent you can’t escape?

You may choose—to stay by his side and uncover his hidden past, or seize a moment to run from this dangerous man.

But once you decide—there’s no turning back.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651510/]Steam[/url]]
